keyEvents.text: Mikel Merino (Arsenal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Arsenal 1, Lille 0. Jurriën Timber (Arsenal) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Noni Madueke.
Substitution, Arsenal. Kai Havertz replaces Viktor Gyökeres.
Substitution, Arsenal. Martin Ødegaard replaces Mikel Merino.
Substitution, Arsenal. Bukayo Saka replaces Noni Madueke.
Goal! Arsenal 2, Lille 0. Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Bukayo Saka.
Goal! Arsenal 3, Lille 0. Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Kai Havertz.
Substitution, Lille. Maurits Kjærgaard replaces Ngal'ayel Mukau.
Substitution, Lille. Osame Sahraoui replaces Nabil Bentaleb.
Substitution, Lille. Calvin Verdonk replaces Romain Perraud.
Substitution, Lille. Olivier Giroud replaces Ayase Ueda because of an injury.
Substitution, Arsenal. Ben White replaces Jurriën Timber.
